questoes.capitulo: Leitura: rotina escolar e regras (must / don't have to)
questoes.texto:
My name is Peter. I'm 14 years old and I go to Hamlet School on weekdays.

My classes start at 8:30 AM.

My favorite subjects are Geography and Science, but I don't really like History. I'm not interested in the past events.

At school, I usually spend time in the lab because I love science.

I also go to the gym on Mondays for P.E. class.

We have many rules at school. We must wear our school uniform every day. We don't have to wear jeans at school.

We have to arrive on time, but we don't have to stay after school unless there is an activity.

Our summer vacation is in June and July. I love spending this time traveling!
questoes.pergunta: Read the text about Peter's school routine. According to the text, what rule does Peter mention about the school uniform, and what rule does he mention about wearing jeans?
